rationale: A fixed small-tree model and regularized standardized linear baseline for a small grouped scenario dataset. Constant filtering and scaling never use internal validation, conformal, policy or outer-test data. No performance-dependent parameter search is performed.
limitations: Grouped validation is internal forecasting evaluation, not final outer-test evaluation.
Shared source rows mean replication group count does not prove population independence.
Training is conditional on admission under the exploratory simulation screen.
No raw-quantile coverage guarantee or release authorization follows from N1 fitting.
